_help: The story script. Each trigger plays once per run, in this order of lines. A line is {"speaker": "Name", "text": "..."} (empty speaker = narration)
or {"ref": "id"} to use a line written by the content pipeline (Generated/dialogue.json).
Triggers: intro, start:<stage> (the stage's build name from campaign.json), engage:pell|dova|clerk, freed:pell|dova|clerk, ending.
Capitals, digits and . , ! ? - : ; ' " ( ) / + % & only; the game's font has no other symbols. Lines over about 200 characters run long.

intro.text: Lanternfall lights its lanterns every dusk, to guide wandering souls home.
Lately fewer souls are arriving. The Tithe has been collecting them, and it has been very polite about it.

intro.speaker: Joseph
intro.text: I saw the first signs. I meant to report them. There was a form.

start:level:streets.speaker: Joseph
start:level:streets.text: The vow, then. No one is left behind the Threshold.

start:level:streets.speaker: Joseph
start:level:streets.text: I say it before every fight. It sounds better when someone else says it.

engage:pell.speaker: Pell
engage:pell.text: Lanterns. Must be lit. Please keep to the lit side of the street.

freed:pell.speaker: Pell
freed:pell.text: Joseph? Is it dusk already? I never finished the lanterns. I think I was doing something else.

freed:pell.speaker: Pell
freed:pell.text: You saw it coming, didn't you. Months ago. You were standing right there.

start:level:cellars.speaker: Joseph
start:level:cellars.text: The Cellars. Dova keeps her stock down here. She would want it counted, and she would want it counted twice.

engage:dova.speaker: Dova
engage:dova.text: No refunds. No exchanges. Mind the crates, they were expensive.

freed:dova.speaker: Dova
freed:dova.text: I would like it noted that I did not authorise any of that. A whole season, gone, and not one receipt.

freed:dova.speaker: Dova
freed:dova.text: Don't be kind to me, it makes me suspicious. I want a refund.

start:level:rooftops.speaker: Joseph
start:level:rooftops.text: The rooftops. The Astral Plane keeps bridges up here. It does not mention them.

start:level:tithe_hall.speaker: Joseph
start:level:tithe_hall.text: The Tithe's Hall. Forms on every wall. None of them are mine, I hope.

start:keep.speaker: Joseph
start:keep.text: Four doors, four sigils. The Keep wants its due before it opens the gate.

start:boss:clerk.text: You hear your old teacher's voice, or you remember it.

engage:clerk.speaker: Joseph
engage:clerk.text: Form 7. Of course there's a form. There is always a form.

ending.text: The Clerk files itself away, and every lantern in Lanternfall lights at once, which has never happened before.
The Tithe will send a reply. It will be polite.

ending.speaker: Joseph
ending.text: Tomorrow, then. I'll write the report tomorrow.
